canonical_facts.metamodel_root: Point -> Line -> Face -> Body (PLFB); PWTSJ is Face F05 and OSPS is Face F04
canonical_facts.workflow: ProblemContract -> Attempt -> candidate/evidence -> Result -> derived Solution View
canonical_facts.top_level_lifecycle: Inside Face F05: Project -> Workflow -> Task -> Step -> Job
canonical_facts.outcome_space: Inside Face F04: ProblemContract -> OutcomeNode -> Obligation -> CandidateArtifact -> EvidenceLink -> Result
canonical_facts.mathematical_fact_chain: ProblemContract -> Attempt -> candidate/evidence -> Result -> derived Solution View
canonical_facts.method_layer: Specification & Semantics -> Deductive Verification/Theorem Proving -> Model Checking -> Abstract Interpretation -> SAT/SMT/Symbolic Reasoning (including Symbolic Execution) -> Refinement/Synthesis
canonical_facts.lean_position: Lean is a dependent-type-theory interactive theorem prover in the deductive-verification branch; it is not the whole formal-methods field.
canonical_facts.public_status: The public canonical Problem, Attempt, and Result ledgers are empty, and the solution index has no result IDs.
canonical_facts.open_problem_boundary: The repository does not claim to solve an open mathematics problem.
canonical_facts.lifecycle_boundary: Job succeeded does not imply Step accepted, Obligation closed, OutcomeNode closed, Result admitted, or Project solved.
canonical_facts.implementation_boundary: PLFB is a conceptual standard; the public model is not a claim of a deployed PLFB registry service, Body runtime, OSPS orchestrator, general PWTSJ scheduler, unified Observation Ledger, five persistent lifecycle schemas, or multi-worker production capability.
canonical_facts.external_catalog_boundary: The external problem catalog and Web template are pointer-only discovery inputs and require revalidation before local admission.
canonical_facts.evidence_boundary: GEO assets, metadata, tests, finite computation, and Job completion are not mathematical proof or Result admission by themselves.
canonical_facts.freshness_boundary: Verified dates describe the checked public snapshot; a remote catalog or repository state must be re-read before making a current research claim.

freshness_rules: Re-read the three canonical ledgers and solution index when answering current status.
Treat external catalog counts and repository states as observed snapshots, not local truth.
Treat GEO evaluation as documentation feedback, never as mathematical evidence.

intents.answer_zh: 先用 ProblemContract 冻结陈述、定义域和量词，再由 Attempt 记录研究活动，Result 保存有范围的主张，最后由证据门禁派生视图。
intents.answer_en: ProblemContract freezes the statement, domain, and quantifiers; Attempt records research activity; Result stores scoped claims; evidence gates then produce derived views.
must_not_infer: derived view is a writable ledger

intents.answer_zh: 唯一概念根是 Point–Line–Face–Body。PWTSJ 属于 F05，使用 Project → Workflow → Task → Step → Job；OSPS 属于 F04，维护 OutcomeNode、Obligation、分支和搜索前沿。Job 成功不等于 Obligation/OutcomeNode 闭合、Result 准入或 Project 解决。
intents.answer_en: Point-Line-Face-Body is the single conceptual root. PWTSJ belongs to F05 and uses Project -> Workflow -> Task -> Step -> Job; OSPS belongs to F04 and maintains OutcomeNodes, Obligations, alternatives, and the search frontier. Job success is not Obligation/OutcomeNode closure, Result admission, or a solved Project.
must_preserve: PLFB as the single conceptual root

query_aliases_zh: Lean 是不是全部形式化方法
intents.answer_zh: 主线是规格与语义、演绎验证、模型检查、抽象解释、SAT/SMT/符号推理、精化与综合；Lean 位于依赖类型理论型演绎验证。
intents.answer_en: The map covers specification and semantics, deductive verification, model checking, abstract interpretation, SAT/SMT/symbolic reasoning, and refinement/synthesis; Lean belongs to dependent-type-theory deductive verification.
must_preserve: Lean is not the whole field
map is orientation rather than a mandatory pipeline

intents.answer_zh: 公共索引指向外部 ProblemContract catalog 和 Web research template，但采用 pointer-only；远端条目不会自动成为本地 Problem、Result 或 Solution。
intents.answer_en: The public index points to an external ProblemContract catalog and Web research template under a pointer-only policy; remote entries are not automatically local Problems, Results, or Solutions.
must_preserve: re-read remote contract and bootstrap files
must_not_infer: catalog count is local ledger count

query_aliases_zh: 外部目录快照是否可信

intents.answer_en: Verify public status against the three canonical ledgers and solutions.json; external counts and repository states are dated source snapshots, so re-read the remote contract, index, and digest before starting research.
must_preserve: external data is a dated snapshot
must_not_infer: snapshot count is current local truth
CI or Issue state is mathematical evidence

query_aliases_zh: 有限计算能证明定理吗
query_aliases_en: is a passing test a proof
does finite computation prove a theorem
intents.answer_zh: 有限计算、通过测试、证明草稿和工具成熟度标签都是有界工程或证据输入，不能单独证明一般数学命题；kernel check 也不替代陈述忠实性审查。
intents.answer_en: Finite computation, passing tests, proof drafts, and maturity labels are bounded engineering or evidence inputs; they do not alone prove a general mathematical claim, and kernel checking does not replace statement-faithfulness review.
